multipleChoice.title: First step (example)
multipleChoice.prompt: In a sell-side process, what usually happens before the buyer sees the confidential information memorandum?

options.text: The buyer signs a non-disclosure agreement
The buyer submits a binding offer

explanation: Buyers sign an NDA first so that confidential information stays protected.
Binding offers and the purchase agreement come much later.

multipleChoice.title: Indications of interest (example)
multipleChoice.prompt: What is an indication of interest?

options.text: A non-binding statement of price range and terms

explanation: It shows a buyer's preliminary view of value so the seller can choose who continues.
